name: [VOLKOV] Operator Sidearm
description: Standard-issue Volkov sidearm. The note etched on the grip reads: one round, one result.

name: [VOLKOV] Chamber Load
description: A heavy Volkov revolver, each chamber toleranced by hand. Slower than it needs to be, on purpose.

name: [VOLKOV] Frame Breach
description: A short Volkov breaching gun, built for corridors. The spread is a specification.

name: [TIANXIA] Workforce Sidearm
description: Tianxia issue for compliance staff, made in volumes that make quality control a hope. They ship anyway.

name: [TIANXIA] Compliance Revolver
description: Issued to Tianxia shift supervisors. The weight is intentional. So is the noise.

name: [TIANXIA] Crowd Management Unit
description: Not a weapon, officially. A crowd management tool. The difference is in the paperwork.

name: [CBN] Dermal Injector
description: A CBN capsule pistol. The chamber takes whatever the clinic loads into it.

name: [CBN] Vascular Punch
description: A slow CBN revolver. The rounds come in unlabelled sleeves.

name: [CBN] Aerosol Dispersal Frame
description: A CBN dispersal frame with a wide bell. The safety notice has been scraped off.

name: [IOA] Dock Security Sidearm
description: IOA platform security issue. The clearance tag is still wired to the trigger guard.

name: [IOA] Platform Enforcer
description: A heavy IOA sidearm, marked for use on crews working without clearance.

name: [IOA] Boarding Suppressor
description: A wide IOA gun for boarding actions. The paperwork calls it a suppressor.
